desc: Analyze the problem and identify that the operation preserves primitive components and allows permuting them.
Verify that all valid parenthesis sequences are fixed points under the specific reverse-swap operation.
Conclude that the problem reduces to counting distinct permutations of the multiset of primitive components.
Formulate the solution as calculating the multinomial coefficient $\frac{m!}{\prod (\text{count}(P_i))!} \pmod{998244353}$.
Implement the parser to decompose $S$ into primitive components.
Implement the calculation of factorials and modular inverses for the multinomial coefficient.
Write the final Python code to read input, solve, and print the result.
